title: Automation Protocol for High-Efficiency and High-Quality Genomic DNA Extraction
author: Nina Alperovich

steps.title: Prepare Zymolyase stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve Zymolyase 20T to 1 U/µL in 1× PBS, aliquot 800 µL, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 2‑Mercaptoethanol stock
steps.instruction: Dilute 2‑Mercaptoethanol 1000‑fold into 1× PBS to obtain a 0.001 % solution and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare digestion master mix
steps.instruction: In a fresh tube combine 22.72 mL 1× PBS, 800 µL Zymolyase stock (1 U/µL), 160 µL 0.001 % 2‑Mercaptoethanol, and 320 µL RNase A/T1 mix; prepare fresh before each use.

steps.title: Prepare 4× lysate buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 30 mL nuclease‑free water, 60 mL 20 % SDS, 4 mL 0.5 M EDTA, and 6 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare magnetic beads stock
steps.instruction: Vortex Speed‑Bead magnetic beads to resuspend, aliquot 1 mL into 1.7 mL tubes, place on a 12‑tube magnetic rack until beads collect and supernatant clears, remove supernatant, add 1 mL 1× TE buffer, remove from magnet and vortex; repeat wash (remove supernatant, add TE, vortex) two more times, then store in the dark at 4 °C. Bring to room temperature and vortex before use.

steps.title: Prepare bead‑PEG‑NaCl binding buffer
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL conical tube add 9 g PEG‑8000, 10 mL 5 M NaCl, 500 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8, 500 µL 0.5 M EDTA, and nuclease‑free water to the 40 mL mark; vortex every 1–2 min until PEG dissolves, add 27.5 µL Tween‑20 and invert 4–6 times. Vortex the magnetic‑bead stock, then add beads: 3 mL for liquid cultures or 1 mL for colonies. Fill to the 50 mL mark with water, mix to a uniform brown color, wrap in foil (or keep in a dark container) and store at 4 °C; vortex before use.

steps.title: Prepare yeast liquid cultures
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1.5 mL (OD₆₀₀ = 1) into 1–3 columns of a 96‑well spin plate using an automated multichannel pipette, centrifuge at 3700 g for 10 min at 10 °C, remove supernatant with the liquid handler, set a minimum tip‑to‑bottom distance of 2.5 mm, leaving ~50 µL of pellet plus residual liquid; seal with an aluminum‑foil lid and rubber roller, store at –20 °C, then defrost at 4 °C for 30–60 min before extraction.

steps.title: Prepare yeast colonies
steps.instruction: Pick individual colonies from an agar plate, resuspend each in 50 µL PBS in 1–3 columns of a 96‑well spin plate; proceed with DNA extraction as described below.

steps.title: Add digestion master mix
steps.instruction: Pipette 315 µL digestion master mix into each well containing a cell pellet or resuspended colony and mix by aspirating and dispensing 30 times.

steps.title: Transfer to reaction plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the 315 µL from each sample well to a corresponding well of a new reaction plate placed on a thermal‑regulated microplate shaker.

steps.title: Digest at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction plate at 37 °C for 25 min while shaking at 400 rpm.

steps.title: Add 4× lysate buffer
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL 4× lysate buffer into each well and mix by aspirating and dispensing 3 times.

steps.title: Lyse at 75 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 75 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Move plate to room‑temp shaker
steps.instruction: Place the reaction plate on a microplate shaker set to room temperature.

steps.title: Add bead‑PEG‑NaCl buffer
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL magnetic bead/PEG‑NaCl binding buffer into each well and mix by repeated aspiration and dispense before each transfer.

steps.title: Mix beads with lysate
steps.instruction: After adding the binding buffer, mix the beads with the lysate by a single aspiration and dispense.

steps.title: Bind DNA at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 7 min while shaking at 300 rpm (binding buffer to lysate ratio 0.48, 200 µL : 415 µL).

steps.title: Capture beads with magnet
steps.instruction: Transfer the plate to a 96‑well magnetic base, let the beads collect for 5 min.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant (~615 µL) from each well.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL 80 % ethanol to each well, wait 1 min, then discard the ethanol supernatant.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL 80 % ethanol to each well, wait 1 min, then discard the ethanol supernatant.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: After the large‑volume removal, use smaller (≈50 µL) tips to aspirate any remaining supernatant from the bottom of each well.

steps.title: Dry bead pellets
steps.instruction: Allow the magnetic bead pellets to air‑dry for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute DNA at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Move the plate to a 60 °C shaker, add 100 µL nuclease‑free water (or EB) to each well, resuspend beads by aspirating and dispensing 12 times, incubate at 60 °C for 10 s while shaking at 1000 rpm, then continue incubation at 60 °C for 7 min while shaking at 400 rpm.

steps.title: Capture eluate with magnet
steps.instruction: Return the plate to the magnetic base, let beads collect for 5 min.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to clean well
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (containing DNA) from each well to a clean well on the same plate (still on the magnet), then wait 5 min.

steps.title: Collect DNA in elution plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate to the corresponding well of an elution plate and cover the plate with a universal lid.

steps.title: Optional proteinase K treatment
steps.instruction: If protein contamination is a concern, add 10 µL Proteinase K solution to each well and incubate at 50 °C for 25 min.
